Q876.reason: The $500 was paid with title passing, so that is false pretenses rather than larceny by trick; the unconsented surgery is battery, and death caused by the reckless, deceptive surgery supports murder.

Q902.reason: Diarrhoea is a measurable (sensible) GI loss, whereas fever and dry oxygen increase insensible skin and respiratory loss, so I'm changing my earlier answer.

Q905.reason: Operating and repairing a municipal water system is treated here as a governmental function, so sovereign immunity bars the claim; the independent-contractor rule has exceptions and isn't the best basis.
